mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id as orderId, order_no as orderNo, merchant_id as merchantId, operator_id as operatorId, operator_name as operatorName, operation_type as operationType, operation_desc as operationDesc, before_status as beforeStatus, after_status as afterStatus, remark, extend_data as extendData, create_time as createTime FROM order_operation_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
